variants.name: 프리미어 통합형
variants.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup.
Produce ONE beautifully crafted high-fidelity UI DETAIL DESIGN BOARD for a Premiere Pro podcast auto-editing extension. The user rejected earlier generic mockups because the visual design of the actual controls lacked refinement. This must show product-design craft at close range: typography, spacing, borders, icon consistency, hover/selected states, precise slider and switch components. It is not a feature diagram.
COMPOSITION: landscape 16:9, high resolution. On the left approximately 60% of the canvas, ONE complete large extension panel shown flat front-on, with all its UI sharp and legible. On the right approximately 32%, a carefully aligned small component specimen column shows three ENLARGED detail crops/components from that exact same visual design system: the speaker-camera mapping row, the slider/toggle controls, and primary/secondary buttons in normal/hover/disabled states. Narrow margins, thoughtful whitespace, no fake laptop, no monitor bezel, no macOS titlebar buttons, no full Premiere screenshot, no timeline app in the background, no giant photos, no wireframe. The panel itself is the subject and occupies most of the image.
Make the board look like an excellent senior product designer's final Figma review, with cohesive, realistically implementable desktop controls. Flat crisp surfaces, controlled depth where appropriate, optical alignment. Every panel edge, label baseline, control height and spacing should feel intentional. Avoid a generic SaaS dashboard, huge radius pills, rainbow boxes, inflated empty cards, KPI tiles, decorative charts, glow, sci-fi, fake glass, gratuitous shadows and stock-art decoration.
CONTENT: actual functional UI for selecting Premiere sources, auto synchronization, speaker-to-camera mapping, cut settings and generating a new editable sequence while preserving originals. Exactly TWO people are mapped: 진행자 → CAM 1 and 게스트 → CAM 2. WIDE is a fallback camera, NEVER a third speaker. Use at most TWO very small photographic avatar thumbnails of fictional Korean adult speakers; waveform sample controls may be present. No large podcast photo is necessary.
Korean typography: refined Pretendard-style sans serif, regular-weight readable body and semibold headings; real optical kerning. Use tabular figures for time and numeric values. Keep labels verbatim. Main panel title "화자 자동 편집", secondary metadata "팟캐스트 EP.12  ·  48:32". Input segmented control "프로젝트 클립" / "현재 시퀀스". Section labels "소스", "싱크", "화자 연결", "편집 설정". Sync action "자동 싱크"; state "싱크 완료" can be a quiet status line. Recording switch "개별 마이크" / "혼합 녹음". Names "진행자", "게스트"; cameras "CAM 1", "CAM 2", "WIDE"; fallback caption "전체 화면". Each person row has a restrained voice-sample play control. Settings "최소 컷 길이" with value "2.0초"; toggle exact text "짧은 반응에 화면 유지". Review link "확인 필요 1" and "검토하기". Primary CTA exactly "편집 시퀀스 만들기". Footer note exactly "원본 유지 · 새 시퀀스 생성".
Right specimen column headings are simply "01  연결", "02  컨트롤", "03  버튼". Keep sample state labels short: "기본", "선택", "비활성". A small board title above the panel specifies the concept, but no essay, no marketing copy. Do not print technical implementation terms, hex color codes, or measurement annotations in the UI. All visible words should be deliberate and readable.
DESIGN SYSTEM 01 — GRAPHITE. Small board title "01  GRAPHITE". Quiet premium dark editor design. Outer board matte #111216; panel #202125; input wells #191A1E; elevated interactive rows #292A30; hairlines #3A3C43. Text ivory #F0F0F3, secondary #A5A6AF. Controlled desaturated lilac #B4A3FF accent. Not saturated purple flood fills. 8px rhythm, panel padding visually 24px, sections separated by 24px, row content gaps 12px. Apparent type scale: title 22, section 14 semibold, body 13, note 11; all comfortably enlarged on this board. Mostly 5px corner radii; perfect 1px borders. Header contains small waveform logomark and tiny connected dot, no huge icon. Flat compact tab strip instead of numbered wizard. Speaker rows are elegant horizontal rows with 32px avatar, name and quiet microphone identifier, a subtle connector arrow, integrated camera dropdown. Selected mapping gets only a thin lilac left rail and faint fill. Sliders are very thin with a small precise circular thumb and well-aligned numeric field; switches are 28x16 logical size. Primary button is refined solid lilac with dark typography, height 40 logical px, small scissors icon, subtle top highlight only. Component specimens show exact hover border and focus ring details. Think refined professional editing utility with the polish of a carefully made modern desktop tool.
